notes: USGS ComCat is a mixed-contributor catalog; general USGS public-domain guidance does not establish rights for every source contribution in this exported record set. Rights/shareability for this extract are unresolved; do not reuse externally before a source-specific review.

The export retains the raw event type. Legacy parsing can exclude listed anthropogenic/explosion types, but that does not certify complete screening of induced seismicity, mines, quarries, or injection operations; H50-S1 does not use this file.

The optional horizontalError field does not provide a full event-location covariance. Its units/statistical meaning were not verified for each network; legacy imputation/weighting is not an uncertainty-aware ACLUD reproduction.
This extract is not approved as a current external competition input. See data/external/README.md and docs/research/data-rights-audit-20261006.md.
